meta.name: glycoengineering
meta.description: Analyze and engineer protein glycosylation. Scan sequences for N-glycosylation sequons (N-X-S/T), predict O-glycosylation hotspots, and access curated glycoengineering tools (NetOGlyc, GlycoShield, GlycoWorkbench). For glycoprotein engineering, therapeutic antibody optimization, and vaccine design.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 分析蛋白质糖基化位点,辅助抗体与疫苗设计
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你在做治疗性抗体或疫苗的糖基化设计。
copy.tagline_en: Analyze protein glycosylation sites to support antibody and vaccine design.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you engineer glycosylation for therapeutic antibodies or vaccines.

howto.what: 装好后,Claude 能扫描蛋白质序列中的 N-糖基化位点、预测 O-糖基化热点,给出突变建议,并引导接入 NetOGlyc、GlycoShield 等外部糖基化工具与数据库。
howto.when: 当用户要求分析抗体 Fc 糖基化、设计疫苗抗原的糖基遮蔽或比对生物类似药糖型等糖蛋白相关任务时触发。

say.text: 扫描这条蛋白序列的N-糖基化位点。
say.note: 会返回位点位置和前后序列。

say.text: 预测这段序列的O-糖基化热点。
say.note: 按局部 S/T 密度给出候选位点。

say.text: 把 IgG1 Fc 的 N297 突变成 Q 会怎样?
say.note: 会说明去除 Fc 糖基化的影响。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can scan protein sequences for N-glycosylation sequons, predict O-glycosylation hotspots, suggest glycoengineering mutations, and point to external tools like NetOGlyc, GlycoShield, and glycan databases.
howto.when_en: Triggered when users ask about antibody Fc glycan optimization, vaccine glycan shielding, biosimilar glycan comparison, or other glycoprotein-related tasks.

say_en.text: Scan this protein sequence for N-glycosylation sites.
Predict O-glycosylation hotspots in this sequence.
say_en.note: Flags candidates based on local S/T density.

say_en.text: What happens if I mutate N297 to Q in IgG1 Fc?
say_en.note: Explains the effect of removing Fc glycosylation.
